title: Douse
summary: DOUSE, verb transitive [Gr.] 1. To thrust or plunge into water. 2. In seamens language, to strike or lower in haste; to slacken suddenly. douse the top-sail. DOUSE, verb intransitive To fall suddenly

inlines.v: DOUSE, verb transitive [Gr.] 1. To thrust or plunge into water. 2. In seamens language, to strike or lower in haste; to slacken suddenly. douse the top-sail. DOUSE, verb intransitive To fall suddenly into water.
